Start your ballet year in sunny Spain with Don Quixote, ballet's greatest 'rom-com', full of tutus, sparkles, love and laughter.

Gorgeous dancing combines with comic flair as feisty couple Kitri and Basilio navigate the twists and turns of their romance, helped - and hindered - by the blunders of the deluded Don Quixote, who stumbles into their story as he dreams of noble quests and knightly adventures.

With dashing matadors, flirtatious fan dances and thrilling pas de deux, Don Quixote is a joyful romp through some of ballet's funniest, sunniest moments, an intoxicating feast for all the senses and a delight for audiences of all ages.

Our 2027 Winter Season promises to be an inspiring celebration of the power and possibilities of ballet, with a suite of three one-act ballets that will showcase the strength and style of the RNZB.

The centrepiece of the programme is the dazzling Kingdom of the Shades act from 19th century classic La Bayadère: a celebration of perfect classical technique and a mesmerising kaleidoscope pattern of white-clad ballerinas that fills the stage with snowy tutus and moonlit wonder. Supremely challenging for the dancers and an unforgettable experience for the audience, the Kingdom of the Shades has never been performed by the RNZB

For Christmas 2027, the Royal New Zealand Ballet is proud to present the world premiere of Sarah Foster-Sproull's Alice in Wonderland.

From the White Rabbit to the Queen of Hearts, the Mad Hatter to the Cheshire Cat, the larger-than-life characters of Alice in Wonderland have transcended the pages of the beloved novel to become part of the timeless fabric of growing up.

At the heart of the classic tale is Alice herself: independent, curious and endlessly brave. Whether conversing with a giant caterpillar or navigating a cutthroat game of croquet, Alice remains true to herself in a topsy-turvy world.
